title: Share a setup as a template (admins)
breadcrumb: Share a setup as a template (admins)

slides.title: Export the draft
slides.html: Tap ≡, scroll the tools to OpenDefence Main, scroll the pane to its end and tap Export. Your draft is saved as a template file in ATAK's export folder.

slides.title: Import a template
slides.html: Copy the file to the other admin's phone, into atak/export, with a USB cable or a file manager. There, tap Import… at the end of the pane and pick the file on the Import page.

slides.title: Check what it holds
slides.html: Check what the file holds, then tap Fill draft. Nothing changes on other phones yet.

slides.title: Review it
slides.html: Your draft now holds the template, here 4 unpublished changes, and Undo brings back the one before. Check the ORBAT and the tiles under Server configuration (admins), then tap Publish… to replace everyone's setup on this TAK server.
